question: The emoluments and allowances of the President and other expenditure relating to his office is charged on the ______ of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Consolidated Fund.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Consolidated Fund of India:**__

__
 
• Revenues received by the government by way of **direct taxes and indirect taxes**, money borrowed and receipts from loans and expenses made by it, excluding the exceptional items, are part of the Consolidated Fund.
 
• This fund was constituted under **Article 266 (1)** of the Constitution of India.
 
• All government expenditure is made from this fund, except exceptional items which are met from the Contingency Fund or the Public Account.
 
• No money can be withdrawn from this fund without the Parliament’s approval. 
 
• 
 
The following expenditure shall be expenditure charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India:

 

 
• the **emoluments and allowances of the President** and other expenditures as related to its office.
 
• the salaries and allowances of the Chairman and the Deputy Chairman of the Council of State and the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the House of the People.
 
• debt charges for which the Government of India is liable including interest, sinking fund charges and redemption charges, and other expenditures related to the raising of loans and the service and redemption of Debt.
 
• the salaries, allowances, and pensions were payable to or in respect of Judges of the Supreme Court.
 
• the pension payable to or in respect of Judges of the federal court the pension payable to on respect of the Judges of the High Court.
 
• the salary allowances and pension payable to or in respect of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
 
• any sums required to satisfy any judgement, decree, or award of any Court or Arbitral Tribunal.
 
• any other expenditure declared by the constitution or by Parliament by law to be so charged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****__​Contingency Fund of India:__**

__
 
• This fund was constituted under **Article 267(1) **of the Constitution of India.
 
• This fund is used to meet **unforeseen expenditures** during emergencies, disasters etc.
 
• The Secretary of the Finance Ministry holds this fund on behalf of the President of India.
 
• In 2021, the government raised the size of the fund to Rs 30,000 crore from Rs 500 crore.

**Public Accounts of India:**__

__
 
• This fund was constituted under **Article 266(2)** of the Constitution.
 
• All other public money (other than those covered under the Consolidated Fund of India) received by or on behalf of the Indian Government is credited to this fund.
 
• The public money is constituted from Bank accounts of departments, National savings fund , Provident fund etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• Governor draws a **salary from Consolidated fund of the state** but pension from Consolidated Fund of India.
